title: Microsoft Teams: Audio announcement for recording and transcription
description:
Admins can enable a policy that

plays an audio announcement when recording or transcription starts. This can be

applied tenant-wide or to specific groups. The announcement helps ensure all

participants are informed and improves accessibility awareness.
